title: Damage Control (miniquest)
start: Speak to Bosun Higgs on the docks near the Sarim's Revenge.

recommended.t: Access to a Spa, either from As A First Resort, at the Anachronia Base Camp, or the Endurance relic power.

rewards.t: Whereabouts of Stan's stolen property and Jacob

steps.t: Talk to Bosun Higgs who is next to your ship (if you have just completed the Harbinger miniquest you may need to relog for the chat option to show up). [Chat: 1 Damage Control miniquest. › Accept]
Talk to Rosie in the Waiko marketplace for a ship repair kit in exchange for 2,500 chimes.
Talk to Bosun Higgs to set sail. [Chat: 1 Damage Control miniquest.]
Talk to Bosun Higgs when you arrive on Goshima
Collect the 6 cannon parts at the locations shown, while avoiding the malignant entity.
Take the Goshima note hanging on the left wooden pillar next to the gate entrance.
Talk to Bosun Higgs. [Chat: 1 Damage Control miniquest.]
